scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp -r functions build/functions && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=ee2f4a3e6d0f6c7ad40eaa7edb321bd1 npx wrangler pages deploy build --project-name vnta --branch main --commit-dirty=true && (node scripts/indexnow.mjs || true)
